entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana María Falú is an Argentine architect and a social activist for human rights and for women's rights. She has been Regional Director of the United Nations Development Fund for Women for the Andean Region (2002–2004) and for Brazil and the Southern Cone Countries (2004–2009). She is a researcher and Professor at the National University of Córdoba (UNC), where she is the Director of the Housing and Habitat Research Institute (INVIHAB). In the field of feminist action, she promoted numerous institutional initiatives and contributed to the establishment of women's rights to the city, to housing, and to the habitat.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As Regional Director of the United Nations Development Fund for Women, Ana Falú promoted women's rights to housing and habitat, contributing to the establishment of a regional framework that has impacted millions of people in South America. Her work at the National University of Córdoba has also informed policy and research on feminist action and urban planning.
